comments.author: TheDasta
comments.body_html:
For anyone wondering why they’re getting an error selling guns to the flea:

Found In Raid guns will sell normally. Non-Found In Raid guns need to be manually sold to flea market, flea’d piece by piece, or can be sold to a trader as a combined item. Not sure why, but in the meantime, the workaround is just to sell Non-Found In Raid guns manually to the flea, piece by piece, or to traders.

Mod dev will probably fix it whenever they get a chance, but in the meantime, this will help you avoid the error.

Quick edit: When selling piece by piece, make sure there’s nothing on the piece (ie. iron sights on a handguard), the error seems to be when Non-FIR items are stacked.
